stem.en: A chemical was once sold as a slimming pill. It punches holes in the dam. Kabir says "so it would give you more energy". What did it do?

text.en: It made the fall into heat instead of coins. Users burned fat and sugar fast, and ran hot; some died of fever. More burning, less ATP, and a body at the temperature of a short circuit.

feedback.en: More burning, yes. Less usable energy, because none of the fall reaches the turbine. Heat is not ATP.

text.en: No effect, because the dam refills.

feedback.en: The chain refills it, and it leaks again, round and round, as heat. That is exactly the danger.
Holes speed burning. Only blocking the last puller or jamming the turbine stops it.

explanation.en: Ask where the fall goes. Through the turbine: coins. Through holes: heat. The pill chose heat, and the body cannot survive much of that.
